note.en: A shortlist comes before a commitment.

intro.en: How does importing a car actually work? Follow one car from the first shortlist to a New Zealand handover.
intro.zh: 一辆海外的车，是怎样来到你手里的？跟着这辆车，从最初的车源筛选，一路看到新西兰交付。

text.en: First, we find and compare overseas candidates.
text.zh: 第一步，寻找并比较海外候选车辆。

text.en: Where the car comes from—and what happens next.
text.zh: 车从哪里来，接下来要做什么。

takeaway.en: Scroll to follow the story. Explore the details whenever you like.
takeaway.zh: 往下看，了解整个过程。想多了解的地方，再点开。

detailTitle.en: Where do the cars come from?

text.en: We source through Japanese dealer stock and auctions, selected Chinese manufacturers and suppliers, and Macau market opportunities. We also continue to explore other overseas channels suited to right-hand-drive vehicles. The appropriate source depends on the vehicle, your budget and the information available.
text.zh: 我们的采购渠道包括日本车商库存与拍卖、精选中国主机厂及供应商，以及澳门市场车源；同时持续拓展其他适合右舵市场的海外渠道。具体渠道会根据车型、预算和可取得的资料匹配。

title.en: A candidate is not a confirmed purchase
title.zh: 候选车辆不等于已确认购买

text.en: A listing is a starting point. Its availability and details need to be checked before a purchase commitment.
text.zh: 车源介绍只是起点。决定购买前，还需要再次确认是否可采购及具体车辆信息。

intro.en: Availability is checked again. We review the available condition information, photos and key documents, and explain any known concerns or gaps.
intro.zh: 再次核对车源状态，查看可取得的车况资料、照片和关键文件，把已知问题与尚未确认的信息说明白。

text.en: Review the evidence and clarify questions.
text.zh: 核对资料，解释需要注意的地方。

text.en: What is known about the car—and what is not yet verified.
text.zh: 已知车况是什么，哪些事项仍未核实。

takeaway.en: A listing or report does not answer every question. Unknowns should stay visible.
takeaway.zh: 车源介绍或报告不是全部答案，未确认事项应明确保留。

text.en: Reconfirm the listing and cross-check the model, specification and recorded mileage against the supplied information.
text.zh: 再次确认车源，并将车型、版本、配置和记录里程与所提供资料交叉核对。

text.en: Review the available photos, condition notes and relevant documents. The depth of review depends on the source and what can actually be obtained.
text.zh: 查看可用照片、车况记录及相关文件。审核范围取决于具体渠道和实际能取得的资料。

text.en: Known concerns, missing information and questions that require further checking should be discussed before you decide.
text.zh: 已知问题、缺失资料及需进一步核实的事项，应在作出购买决定前说明。

note.zh: 包含什么，估算什么，还有什么待确认。

intro.en: The source-market price is only one part. An itemised estimate explains the expected vehicle, transport, local and service costs—and what is not included.
intro.zh: 海外车价只是其中一部分。分项估算应说明车辆、运输、本地办理和服务等预计费用，也要写清不包含的项目。

text.en: Break down the expected costs and their scope.
text.zh: 拆开说明费用，以及每一项的范围。

text.en: Which amounts are confirmed, estimated or still to be determined.
text.zh: 哪些金额已确认，哪些是估算，哪些仍待确定。

takeaway.en: Understand the cost scope before agreeing to the purchase arrangements.
takeaway.zh: 先了解费用范围，再决定是否同意购买安排。

detailTitle.en: What should a cost breakdown show?
detailTitle.zh: 一份费用明细应该讲清什么？

text.en: The vehicle amount and the sourcing or overseas charges included in the proposed arrangement.
text.zh: 车辆金额，以及所提出安排中包含的采购或海外相关费用。

text.en: The applicable freight, taxes, local processing, checks, registration and service items should be identified—not hidden inside an unexplained total.
text.zh: 适用的运输、税费、本地处理、检查、注册和服务项目应逐项说明，而不是只给一个无法解释的总数。

text.en: Identify variable amounts, allowances, exclusions and anything needing a vehicle-specific confirmation. This walkthrough is not a quotation or calculator.
text.zh: 标明浮动金额、预留估算、不包含项目及需按具体车辆确认的事项。本流程展示不是报价，也不进行费用计算。

note.en: The route, the handover and the next update.
note.zh: 运输路线、交接，以及下一步信息。

intro.en: Once the purchase arrangements are agreed, the vehicle moves through export handover and shipping. We explain the available shipment information and the next local steps.
intro.zh: 购买安排确认后，车辆进入出口交接和运输阶段。我们说明可取得的运输信息，并衔接后续本地环节。

text.en: Coordinate the handover, transport and arrival arrangements.
text.zh: 协调交接、运输与到港衔接。

text.en: What stage comes next and how timing updates are communicated.
text.zh: 接下来是什么环节，以及如何了解时间变化。

takeaway.en: Shipping dates are estimates until the relevant arrangements are confirmed.
takeaway.zh: 相关安排确认前，船期与到港时间应按预计理解。

detailTitle.zh: 两个港口之间，有哪些环节？

text.en: Confirm the vehicle collection, handover information and paperwork for the particular route.
text.zh: 按具体运输线路确认接车、交接资料及所需文件。

text.en: Explain the available shipment details and communicate material changes to the expected schedule.
text.zh: 说明可取得的运输资料，并沟通预计时间的重要变化。

text.en: Arrange the next local steps using the actual arrival and release information. The illustration is not a live vessel or order tracker.
text.zh: 根据实际到港与放行信息安排后续本地环节。画面是流程示意，不是实时船舶或订单追踪。

note.en: The checks, any work and the preparation.
note.zh: 检查、所需处理与交付准备。

intro.en: Arrival is not the finish line. Local processing, applicable checks, any required work and registration need to be addressed before an agreed handover.
intro.zh: 到港并不等于可以直接交车。还需要衔接本地处理、适用检查、可能需要的整改，以及注册和交付准备。

text.en: Coordinate the local steps and explain issues that need attention.
text.zh: 协调本地环节，说明需要处理的事项。

text.en: What is ready, what remains outstanding and any related costs.
text.zh: 哪些事项已具备条件，哪些仍待处理，以及相关费用。

takeaway.en: Further checks or work may be needed; a pass is not assumed.
takeaway.zh: 可能需要进一步检查或处理，不预先假定车辆通过。

detailTitle.en: Why is arrival not the last step?
detailTitle.zh: 为什么到港还不能直接交车？

text.en: The relevant release, collection and inspection arrangements depend on the actual vehicle and its requirements.
text.zh: 放行、提车和检查安排取决于具体车辆及适用要求。

text.en: If checks identify issues, the required work, timing and related charges need to be explained and addressed.
text.zh: 检查发现问题时，需要说明并处理相应工作、时间安排及相关费用。

text.en: Complete the applicable registration and preparation steps, then confirm when and how the handover will take place.
text.zh: 按实际情况完成注册和准备环节，再确认何时、怎样交付。

note.en: Your car, your paperwork, your point of contact.
note.zh: 车辆、文件，以及联系渠道。

intro.en: Review the vehicle, relevant paperwork and agreed items together. Get the practical information you need, with a clear local point of contact for questions.
intro.zh: 一起确认车辆、相关文件和约定事项，了解实用的交付信息，并保留清楚的本地联系渠道。

text.en: Explain the handover details and how to reach us afterwards.
text.zh: 说明交付事项，以及之后怎样联系。

text.en: What you are receiving and who to contact with questions.
text.zh: 交付内容是什么，有问题时可以找谁。

takeaway.en: A local point of contact, during the journey and after handover.
takeaway.zh: 从进口过程到交付之后，都知道可以联系谁。

detailTitle.zh: 交付时会说明哪些事情？

text.en: Go through the vehicle, relevant documents and items agreed as part of the handover.
text.zh: 共同确认车辆、相关文件及约定的交付事项。

text.en: Explain useful controls and the ownership or service information relevant to the particular car.
text.zh: 介绍实用操作，以及适用于这辆车的用车或服务信息。

text.en: Keep INNO’s contact details accessible for follow-up questions. Any specific warranty or service coverage should be explained separately.
text.zh: 保留 INNO 的联系方式，便于后续提问。具体保修或服务覆盖范围应另行说明。
